svg.aria-label: mcp-doctor demo: find a bug that will break an agent (quality 22%, grade F), fix it with mcp-doctor --fix and re-check clean, get a SHIP release verdict on a clean server, and guard a live call that reported success without writing the file
svg.text: mcp-doctor · evals and guardrails for AI agents

g.text: Find what will break an agent, before anyone calls the tool

text.tspan: a client that sends the advertised null default gets
a validation error, and the tool never runs.
Tool has no description. An agent cannot decide when to call this.
Bare 'except:' swallows all errors including cancellation — catch specific exceptions.

g.text: Fix it in place, and the re-check comes back clean

text.tspan: (checked: null defaults, stdout on stdio, mcp 2.x start-up)

g.text: Launch a server, fuzz it, and get one release decision
Catch a "success" that didn't happen, live

text.tspan: ⚠ mcp-doctor guard: write_file reported success, but reading it back with
get_file_info(path='/tmp/report.md') failed: "Error: ENOENT: no such file
or directory, stat '/tmp/report.md'". The write may not have happened.
The result still says success (isError: false); guard adds the warning the agent reads,
so it can retry or tell you instead of saying "done".

g.text: Find → Fix → Ship → Guard, in one open-source CLI
Finds 15,755 of 15,977 tools across 805 real MCP servers, every miss published
Fixes merged by maintainers at Microsoft · AWS · NVIDIA · Intel · IBM · Cisco
